battle.name: 中都之戰
battle.brief: 一二一四年春，成吉思汗率蒙古軍進抵金中都城北，列營合圍。中都城牆堅固，蒙古軍改用壕溝、抛石機與撞車壓迫；金軍以火藥器械反擊，五月宣宗南遷汴京，中都遂成孤城。卡面的希臘火是同時代的另一條路：拜占庭以銅管噴射秘方燃燒劑破敵於水陸，此處卻沒有它的位置。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰一方是蒙古帝國的大軍與專門組成的攻城營。草原兵按十進制編為千戶、百戶、十戶，怯薛宿衛分列左右翼護衛大汗與諸王；攻城所需的人力不靠草原抽調，而是就地徵發金地降附的漢軍步卒、雲梯匠、炮手與回回工匠。成吉思汗自領中路，木華黎率左翼經營漢地，其餘各部將領分道掃蕩山東、遼東；一二一四年春大軍抵達中都城下後，圍城交由留營將領接手，成吉思汗本人同年秋天轉向西方。另一方是金朝：宣宗完顏允恭居中都，樞密院與尚書省在城內分權，禁軍宿衛皇城與各門，河北、河東的勤王兵陸續入援，糧秣則仰給中都及河北倉儲。守城由河南經略使、右丞相完顏承裕總攝，契丹人抹胡沒等分守要衝，皇城與內城集中了府庫、宮掖與輜重。蒙古一旦掃平河北山東，金的糧源與兵源立刻斷絕，這是中都守軍看得最清楚、也最無力挽回的處境。南宋與西夏都沒有介入本役：宋人在淮漢一線觀望，西夏自顧不暇，蒙古得以專心對付金朝；真正決定金朝命運的宋蒙聯合，要等到一二三二年之後。
countriesEn: One side was the army of the Mongol Empire together with a siege train raised for the occasion. The steppe troops were organised on a decimal system into thousands, hundreds and tens, with the keshig guard flanking the khan and the princes on either side; the manpower for siege work was not drawn from the steppe but levied on the spot from Han troops who had submitted to the Mongols, together with ladder crews, artillery crews and Huihui craftsmen. Genghis Khan led the central column himself, Muqali commanded the left wing and administered the Chinese lands, and other commanders were sent in separate columns against Shandong and Liaodong; after the army reached the walls of Zhongdu in the spring of 1214 the siege was handed to the commanders left behind, while the khan himself turned westward that same autumn. The other side was the Jin dynasty: under Xuanzong, whose personal name was Wanyan Yungong, the Privy Council and the Department of State Affairs divided authority inside the capital, the imperial guard held the palace city and the gates, reinforcements from Hebei and Hedong arrived in waves, and grain came from the capital and the depots of Hebei. The defence of the city was directed by the Right Chancellor and Henan Circuit Commissioner Wanyan Chengyu, with the Khitan commander Moguma and others holding the vital posts, while the palace city and the inner city concentrated the treasuries, the palace household and the baggage. Once the Mongols swept through Hebei and Shandong, the sources of grain and of men for the Jin were cut off at once, and this was the plainest fact of the position the garrison could see and could do nothing about. Neither the Southern Song nor Western Xia intervened in this campaign: the Song watched from the Huai and Han lines, Western Xia had enough on its own hands, and the Mongols were free to concentrate on the Jin; the Song-Mongol alliance that would decide the fate of the Jin did not come until after 1232.
people: 成吉思汗是這場戰爭裡唯一全程在場並親自決策的人。一二一一年野狐嶺一戰，他以中路大軍迂回側翼擊潰金朝主力，奠定北亞格局；一二一三年秋分三路南下，一二一四年春抵中都城北，駐軍紮營而不急於強攻，原因很實際：中都城牆堅固、蒙古的遠征糧道太長，而金廷尚在猶豫遷都與死守之間。他最後選擇了壓迫，等金廷自己南遷再接手收拾。圍城期間他留下木華黎與塔察兒一系的兵力經營漢地，同年秋天率主力西征呼羅珊，把北方的殘局交給木華黎。木華黎是蒙古漢地政策的關鍵人物，他主張以漢制治漢地、保全農事，一二一八年卒於洺州，後來行臺尚書省與河東、河北、山東經略司的架構都由他奠下基礎。塔察兒接續圍中都，到一二一五年中都陷落時已是主攻方向上的實際統帥。金人一邊，宣宗完顏允恭在遷都汴京、留下中都給蒙古這個決定上承擔了後果；完顏承裕主持城防並率殘部南撤；契丹將領抹胡沒死守城門直至城破。稍後耶律楚材隨成吉思汗西行，一二一八年在涿州力勸止屠城，顯示蒙古對待漢地的方式正在改變。與本卡對照的是另一批人物：拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁五世在六七八至六七九年的君士坦丁堡之圍靠希臘火保住海防，一二〇四年第四次十字軍進攻君士坦丁堡時，拉丁人的塔船正是毀在金角灣的火焰裡；一二一四年的中都城下，這兩條技術線沒有交會。
peopleEn: The only man present throughout the campaign who took the decisions himself was Genghis Khan. In 1211, at Yehuling, he sent the central column round the flank and destroyed the main body of the Jin host, setting the pattern for northern Asia; in the autumn of 1213 he marched south in three columns, and in the spring of 1214 the army stood north of Zhongdu, pitching camp rather than assaulting at once, for very practical reasons: the walls of the capital were strong, the Mongol supply line from the steppe was long, and the Jin court was still arguing over whether to flee or to hold. He settled on pressure instead, waiting for the Jin to evacuate on its own and then cleaning up what was left. During the siege he left troops under Muqali's and Tachar's command to administer the Chinese lands and in the same autumn led his main body west against Khurasan, leaving the northern end of the business to Muqali. Muqali was the key figure in Mongol policy towards China: he argued for governing Han territory by Han institutions and for protecting agriculture, and he died at Mingzhou in 1218; the framework of the Branch Secretariat and the circuit administrations of Hedong, Hebei and Shandong was built on what he established. Tachar took over the siege of Zhongdu and was the effective commander on the main axis of attack when the city fell in 1215. On the Jin side, Xuanzong, Wanyan Yungong, bore the consequences of the decision to move the capital to Bianjing and leave Zhongdu to the Mongols; Wanyan Chengyu directed the defence and led the survivors south; the Khitan general Moguma held the gates until the city was taken. Later, Yelü Chucai travelled west with the khan and at Zhuozhou in 1218 pressed him not to slaughter the inhabitants, showing that the Mongol way of treating the Chinese lands was changing. The counterpart to this card lies among a different set of names: the Byzantine emperor Constantine V, whose defences held the sea approaches in the siege of Constantinople in 678–679 thanks to Greek fire, and the Latin knights of the Fourth Crusade, whose tower-ship was destroyed by the flames in the Golden Horn in 1204. Under the walls of Zhongdu in 1214 those two lines of technology never met.
kits: 卡面是希臘火：裝在銅管內、以虹吸管加壓噴出的燃燒劑，配方是帝國的祕密。它是拜占庭最重要的攻城與海戰裝備，六七八至六七九年君士坦丁堡之圍用來燒毀阿拉伯艦隊，七一七至七一八年再挫圍軍，一二〇四年第四次十字軍時又燒毀拉丁人進攻用的塔船；使用時把銅管固定在船首或城頭的木架上，由操作員以活塞打壓，燃料隨之噴出成條火流，覆蓋十數步外的木製目標。本役的攻城方蒙古軍並沒有這類秘密武器，其攻城器材是回回工匠製作的大型投石機與撞車、雲梯，並在城外掘壕環營、切斷城內水源與糧道；一二一四年時火藥炮是否已用於中都尚無一致記載，但這套技術在十餘年後的蔡州之戰（一二三二至一二三三年）已留下蒙古軍以回回炮破城的完整記載。金軍的守城器械以火藥為核心：《金史》所見有「震天雷」與「飛火龍牌」一類火藥器械，前者以鐵殼裝藥、靠引信炸擊聚集之敵與攻城器械，後者形如長槍、施放火藥箭；此外還有裹布的火球、火箭，以及宋金文獻記載的「猛火油」一類傾倒式油料燃燒物。與希臘火相比，猛火油的原理同樣是把可燃油料點著，但沒有銅管壓力，靠人工傾倒，射程短、覆蓋面小，遇上雲梯這種移動目標效果有限。城防本身則是中都的磚砌城牆、壕溝、吊橋、飛石索、拒馬與鹿角柴，另有望敵的高台與聽敵用的地聽。運輸方面，蒙古軍以乾酪、肉乾與驢馬馱運自漠北南下，自大營至中都的運輸線逾一千公里，靠牛車與驛站維持，最終仍因河北饑荒而屢陷缺糧。
kitsEn: The card shows Greek fire: a burning mixture carried in a copper tube and forced out under pressure by a siphon and piston, its formula the empire's most closely guarded secret. It was Byzantium's premier weapon against siege works and at sea. It was used to burn the Arab fleet in the siege of Constantinople in 678–679, to break up the besiegers a second time in 717–718, and to destroy the Latin assault tower-ship in 1204. In use, the tube was bolted to a wooden frame on a ship's prow or on a rampart and an operator worked the piston to drive the fuel out in a jet of flame that could sweep a dozen paces of timber. The Mongols at this siege had no such secret weapon: their siege equipment was the large traction trebuchets and battering rams built by Huihui craftsmen, the scaling ladders, and a campaign of trenching round the camp with the city's water and grain cut off. Whether gunpowder artillery was used against Zhongdu itself in 1214 is not consistently recorded, but the same technology is documented a dozen years later at the siege of Caizhou in 1232–1233, where the Mongols breached the city with Huihui trebuchets. The Jin siege defences were built around gunpowder: the Jin History records devices such as the thunder-crash bomb and the flying fire-dragon tablet, the first a shell of iron casing filled with powder and fired by a fuse to burst among crowded enemy troops and assault machines, the second shaped like a long spear and discharging a powder charge; there were also fireballs of cloth wrapped in powder, fire arrows, and the pourable oil fuel recorded in Song and Jin texts under the name of fierce fire oil. The principle is the same as Greek fire, setting an oil that will burn alight, but with no pressure behind it: the oil was tipped by hand, its range short, its area of coverage small, and its effect limited against a moving target such as a scaling ladder. The city's own defences were the brick-faced walls of Zhongdu, its ditches, drawbridges, stone-thrown slings, cheval-de-frise and caltrops, with watching platforms and devices for listening to the approach. On transport, the Mongols carried dried cheese, dried meat and pack animals down from the steppe; the line of supply from the great camp to Zhongdu ran beyond a thousand kilometres and was kept going by ox-carts and depots, and it still ran short of food in Hebei, where famine followed in the wake of the campaigning.
tactics: 蒙古軍的戰法自野狐嶺一路延續到中都城下。野狐嶺是利用山口的迂回側擊，一二一三年南下則換成分道掃蕩：三路大軍平行推進，每路沿途攻破城邑、切斷交通、徵發糧秣，最終在中都城下會合，構成合圍。金廷正是在這個時候失去判斷依據：中都糧草尚能支撐一年，但河北各府縣已接連易主，援軍的來路被切斷。蒙古軍對中都沒有立即強攻，而是列營挖掘環壕、設置柵欄、斷水，等待金廷自己崩解；成吉思汗的營中禁止劫掠的命令在圍城期間屢次與軍需不足拉鋸，這條軍紀既維持了軍心，也讓金朝各州縣在初期的抵抗顯得脆弱。攻城方真正的難題是牆：雲梯直登屢試不成，撞車撞門效率有限，抛石機的破壞力不足以一次掀開磚牆，這使火藥器械成為攻城技術的關鍵轉折點，也把金軍的守城裝備推上前線。金軍的戰術是以逸待勞：城頭分哨巡邏，密集射擊靠近的攻城器械與填壕的士卒，油料與火藥待敵隊密集時才投擲，出城反擊則選在蒙古營壘分兵或攻城梯就位的一刻，試圖以局部出擊扭轉攻城節奏。金廷的決策在守與走之間反覆，南遷之後中都只剩死守一途。對照希臘火：它的使用前提是目標密集且移動緩慢的戰列或攻城塔船，而一二一四年中都城下沒有密集的希臘式戰船集群可燒，蒙古的雲梯與撞車又是分散移動的目標，銅管火流就算運到也未必命中。希臘火的對象與中都的對象，從一開始就不是同一類。
tacticsEn: The Mongol method carried over from Yehuling all the way to the walls of Zhongdu. Yehuling was a turning movement through a mountain pass to strike the flank; the campaign of 1213 changed it into a sweep in separate columns: three armies advanced in parallel, each breaking the walled towns along its route, cutting roads and requisitioning grain, and finally converging on Zhongdu to close the ring. It was precisely at this point that the Jin court lost its basis for judgement: the capital still had grain for about a year, but the prefectures of Hebei had already changed hands one after another and the road by which reinforcements could come was cut. The Mongols did not at once assault the walls; they ringed the camp with ditches, set up stockades and blocked the water, waiting for the Jin administration to collapse on its own. Genghis Khan's order forbidding plunder in the camp was repeatedly strained by hunger and by the need for supplies, and this discipline held the army together while making the early resistance of the Jin prefectures look brittle. The real difficulty for the besiegers was the wall: scaling ladders failed, battering rams were slow, and the traction trebuchets could not prise open a brick-faced rampart in one throw, which is what made gunpowder the turning point of siege technology at the period and pushed the Jin's own siege weapons to the front line. The Jin method was to wait at ease: watches and patrols on the ramparts, dense fire against assault machines and sappers filling the ditches, oil and powder thrown only when the attackers had closed up, and sallies timed for the moment when a Mongol column was detached or a ladder was set, in the hope that a local counterstroke would break the rhythm of the assault. The court's own choices ran back and forth between holding and leaving, and once the capital had moved, holding was all that was left. By way of counterpoint, Greek fire: its use required a slow, densely packed target, a battle line or a siege tower-ship, and at Zhongdu in 1214 there was no such mass of ships to burn, while the Mongol ladders and rams were dispersed, moving targets that a jet of flame would have been hard to hit even if it had been brought there. The targets of Greek fire and the targets at Zhongdu were never of the same kind.
data: 留下數字的地方主要在《元史·太祖本紀》與《金史》各紀。城池方面：金中都始建於一一五一至一一五三年，完顏亮自上京遷都燕京時重築，設皇城、內城、外城三重，外城周長近二十公里，牆身以磚包夯土，高約十公尺上下，開城門十餘座，外圍有壕溝護城。時間方面：一二一四年春蒙古軍抵達中都城下，史家多繫於三月；五月金宣宗南遷汴京；一二一五年中都陷落，圍城前後延續一年有餘。兵力方面沒有留下可靠確數：蒙古軍在一二一三年南下時分三路，檔案常以「諸道兵」統稱，量級在數萬騎兵上下，攻城營另徵漢地降軍與隨軍工匠；金軍的禁軍、勤王兵與中都守軍同樣沒有編制數字可用，本役的損失記錄除零星提及外亦不完整。可以確定的量級是城垣的規模與圍城的長度：蒙古需要把整座大城完全封鎖，這意味著數十里的壕溝與哨所。兵器方面，一二一四年的中都攻防是火藥武器出現在歐亞攻城記錄裡最早的一批案例之一，《金史》所見「震天雷」「飛火龍牌」說明當時守軍已有可攜式火藥器械；蒙古軍的投石機與火藥炮則在一二三二至一二三三年的蔡州之役留下完整紀錄。希臘火方面有較硬的年表：加冕禮上首次見於官方記載是六八一年，六七八至六七九年的君士坦丁堡之圍是最早的戰役使用記載，一四五三年是最後一次使用。
dataEn: The numbers that survive are mainly in the Annals of the Founding Khan in the Yuan History and in the various annals of the Jin History. On the city: Zhongdu was begun in 1151 and finished in 1153, when Wanyan Liang moved the capital from Shangjing to Yanjing and rebuilt it in three rings, palace city, inner city and outer city. The outer wall ran nearly twenty kilometres, the facing was brick over rammed earth, and the wall stood at roughly ten metres; there were a dozen or more gates and a wet ditch around it. On time: the Mongol army reached the walls in the spring of 1214, usually dated to March; the Jin emperor moved south to Bianjing in May; the city fell in 1215, so the investment ran rather more than a year. On strength no reliable figure survives. The Mongols marched south in three columns in 1213 and the records refer to them collectively as the armies of the several roads, on the order of tens of thousands of horsemen, with a siege train of Han subordinates and craftsmen added on; the Jin guard troops, the regional reinforcements and the garrison of the capital have no muster figures either, and the loss records for the campaign are fragmentary. What can be fixed with confidence is the scale of the fortifications and the length of the investment: the Mongols had to seal a great city completely, which meant tens of li of ditch and picket line. On weapons, the fighting around Zhongdu in 1214 is among the earliest cases in Eurasian siege records involving gunpowder; the thunder-crash bomb and the flying fire-dragon tablet in the Jin History show that the defenders already had portable gunpowder weapons, while the Mongols' traction trebuchets and powder guns are documented in full at Caizhou in 1232–1233. Greek fire has a firmer chronology: its first appearance in an official record was the imperial coronation of 681, its earliest use in a campaign was the siege of Constantinople in 678–679, and its last use was in 1453.
cause: 最表層的原因是草原與農耕地之間的生存競爭：金朝自阿骨打立國起就在北部邊境修壘、納叛、築界壕，與蒙古各部的衝突從金初延續了一百五十餘年，到成吉思汗統一漠北草原，壓力方向反轉過來。第二層是一二一一年野狐嶺之役的毀滅性結果：金朝投入的三路大軍一戰盡沒，河北防務的骨架被打斷，蒙古得以在一二一三年放心分三路深入中原。第三層是金朝自身的內部崩解：財政枯竭、南北饑荒與瘟疫、高麗與遼東的叛離、朝中主戰與主遷的黨爭，都讓中都守軍在敵人尚未抵達時已先失了士氣與準備。遷都與否的爭論在一二一三年底就已開始，多數朝臣主張死守中都，以為城牆與舊都的號令足以拖住蒙古；戰局證明城牆拖住的是敵人，也是自己。對照希臘火：拜占庭面對的圍攻來自阿拉伯人與十字軍，都是備有攻城器械的對手，於是才有專門為毀傷器械與戰船而生的燃燒武器；一二一四年的中都同樣面對有攻城器械與工匠的敵人，卻沒有那樣的秘密技術線，只能靠火藥、猛火油與投石機的數量與精度硬扛。
causeEn: The outermost cause was the competition for survival between the steppe and the ploughed lands. From its founding by Wujin, the Jin had raised ramparts, taken in defectors and dug boundary ditches along the northern frontier, and the friction with the Mongolian tribes had run for a hundred and fifty years; when Genghis Khan united the steppe, the direction of that pressure reversed. The second cause was the annihilation of 1211: the three armies the Jin committed at Yehuling were destroyed in a single action, the framework of the northern defence was broken, and the Mongols could march deep into the Chinese plain in 1213 with confidence. The third cause was the internal disintegration of the Jin, which had begun before the enemy arrived: exhausted finances, famine and plague in the north and south, the defection of Goryeo and the loss of Liaodong, and a court split between those who favoured resistance and those who favoured evacuation. The argument over moving the capital had begun in late 1213, and most ministers wanted to hold at Zhongdu, trusting the walls and the prestige of the old capital to hold the Mongols off; the war showed that the walls would hold the enemy, and themselves. By way of counterpoint, the sieges faced by Byzantium were mounted by Arabs and Crusaders, all equipped with siege machines, and that is why a burning weapon designed specifically to wreck engines and ships came to exist; the Mongols at Zhongdu in 1214 were likewise opposed by men with siege machines and craftsmen, but no such secret line of technology was available to them, and the defence had to be carried by the sheer quantity and precision of powder, oil and stones.
impact: 第一個後果是力量對比的逆轉。一二一四年之前，金在北亞是壓倒性的強國，蒙古只是邊境外的一支游牧力量；中都陷落之後，金朝失去河北平原與北方根本，國號與宮室南遷汴京，北方剩下的只是由數個行省殘部拼成的臨時局面，糧源、兵源與馬源全部斷裂，後來只能靠括戶、加稅與借用南宋的糧道苟延。蒙古則拿到第一座可供經營的漢地大城，一二一五年後木華黎以行臺尚書省與河東、河北、山東經略司的形式接管地方，一二一八年木華黎死後其制度仍被沿用，一二七二年忽必烈建大都於中都舊址東北，是這條線的終點。第二個後果在技術史上：一二一四年的中都攻防是火藥器械進入歐亞大規模攻城記錄的最早一批案例之一，它把守方用火藥炸攻城器械、攻方用火藥炸城牆這兩種用法同時放進同一場戰役，之後沿着一二三二年汴京、一二三三年蔡州的路線一路走向砲。第三個後果在同期另一端：一二一四年的君士坦丁堡仍在拉丁帝國手中，拜占庭餘緒只剩尼西亞的流亡朝廷，希臘火的配方隨沉船與政權崩潰而失傳，此後再也沒有出現在歐亞的戰場上。同一個世紀，一端的燃燒技術退成缺乏滲透力的笨器，另一端從震天雷一路長成火砲。
impactEn: The first consequence was a reversal in the balance of power. Before 1214 the Jin was overwhelmingly the strongest state in northern Asia and the Mongols were only a steppe force beyond the frontier; after the fall of Zhongdu the Jin lost the Hebei plain and its northern base, the imperial house and the court moved south to Bianjing, and what remained in the north was a temporary patchwork of provincial fragments with the sources of grain, of men and of horses all severed, so that the dynasty could thereafter live only by registering households, raising taxes and borrowing grain routes from the Southern Song. The Mongols, for their part, gained their first great Chinese city to administer. After 1215 Muqali took over the districts through the Branch Secretariat and the circuit administrations of Hedong, Hebei and Shandong, and that structure survived his death in 1218; Kublai's construction of Dadu on the north-east of the old Zhongdu site in 1272 was the end of that line. The second consequence belongs to the history of technology: the fighting around Zhongdu in 1214 is among the earliest cases in which gunpowder weapons appear in the siege records of Eurasia, and it put the two uses of powder into a single battle, the defenders using powder to destroy assault machines and the besiegers using powder to breach walls, from which the road led on through Bianjing in 1232 to Caizhou in 1233 and on to artillery. The third consequence lay at the other end of the same century: Constantinople in 1214 was still in Latin hands, the Byzantine remnant was reduced to the exile court in Nicaea, and the formula for Greek fire had gone down with the ships and the fallen regime, never to appear on a Eurasian battlefield again. Within a single century the burning technology at one end retreated into a clumsy weapon with little penetrating power, while at the other it grew from the thunder-crash bomb into the cannon.
result: 一二一四年五月，金宣宗自中都南遷汴京，蒙古軍得以完整地佔有中都；但中都並非當場被強攻而下，守軍在缺糧、斷援的狀態下又撐了數月，一二一五年城破，抹胡沒等將領戰歿，府庫財貨與宮掖器物盡為蒙古軍所取，殘存的金室成員分批南下。蒙古沒有乘勢追滅金廷：黃河正值汛期、水路運糧不繼，加上成吉思汗在一二一四年秋已決定西征呼羅珊，北方戰事交由木華黎一系處理，中原的殘局被拉成數年之久的消耗戰。一二一六至一二一九年間，蒙古逐步平定河北山東殘餘勢力，金朝只剩下以汴京為中心的殘局，一二三二年蒙古大軍再圍汴京，金廷出降，一二三三年蔡州陷落，一二三四年二月金哀宗自縊，末帝完顏承麟與諸妃在城上殉國，金朝亡。戰役留下的兩筆帳是這樣的：蒙古得到了中都與北方，卻用一次西征把收穫的時間拖長；金朝保住了南方，卻把北方與本國元氣一起留在了中都城頭。希臘火沒有出現在這場戰役裡，也永遠不會出現，它的持有者那時正忙於在拉丁人佔領的君士坦丁堡與尼西亞的流亡朝廷之間維持一個帝國的名號，而銅管與那份祕密，在一二六一年君士坦丁堡收復之後再也沒有人真正掌握過。
resultEn: In May 1214 the Jin emperor moved south from Zhongdu to Bianjing, and the Mongols found the city at their disposal; but it was not taken by storm on the spot. Short of food and of relief, the garrison held on for several more months, and the city fell in 1215: Moguma and other commanders were killed, the treasuries and the contents of the palace were taken by the Mongols, and the surviving members of the imperial house went south in parties. The Mongols did not press on to destroy the Jin court: the Yellow River was in flood, the water-borne grain route had failed, and Genghis Khan had already decided in the autumn of 1214 to turn west against Khurasan, so the northern end was left to Muqali's people and the campaign in the Chinese lands stretched into a war of attrition lasting several years. Between 1216 and 1219 the Mongols gradually pacified the remaining resistance in Hebei and Shandong, leaving the Jin a rump state centred on Bianjing; the Mongols besieged Bianjing again in 1232 and the Jin court surrendered, Caizhou fell in 1233, and in the second month of 1234 Emperor Aizong hanged himself, the last emperor Wanyan Chenglin perishing with his consorts on the walls, and the Jin was gone. The two accounts left by the campaign are these: the Mongols won the city and the north, but spent a western campaign stretching out the time in which they collected the prize; the Jin saved the south, but left the north and the strength of the dynasty behind on the walls of Zhongdu. Greek fire took no part in this campaign and never would: its owners were then occupied with keeping the name of an empire alive between Latin-held Constantinople and the exile court in Nicaea, and the copper tube and its secret were never truly in any hand again after Constantinople was recovered in 1261.
